== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Dragon's breath]] is a powerful force of [[destruction]] and fire that originates from the [[dragons]] that once inhabited these lands. It can manifest as various forms of elemental energy, such as black-and-red flames, orange-gold light, or liquid golden streams. While naturally expelled from a [[dragon]]'s jaws, the [[technique]] can also be imitated by others through specialized [[madra]] manipulation. For instance, practitioners of the [[Path of Black Flame]] can project this power from their hands or palms using [[madra]] shells to maintain density and control. The [[technique]] varies significantly in [[scale]] and appearance, ranging from thin, drilling beams that can pierce through a target's heart to massive, river-like torrents of flame that obliterate entire environments. It is often utilized as a [[Striker technique]], capable of searing flesh, melting through defenses like forged walls, or leaving nothing but ash and smoke in its wake. Some variations involve complex [[aura]] manipulation or the integration of [[soulfire]] and [[Authority|authority]] to increase potency. Beyond simple elemental attacks, [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] can serve as a means of nourishment for certain creatures or act as a devastating tool of war that leaves landscapes blackened and ruined.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|During a confrontation, a [[dragon]] utilizes its breath to attack. Later, [[Lindon]] is seen holding a [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] within his palm. [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] also prepares to use the [[technique]] by raising her hand. In the heat of battle, [[Yan Shoumei]] discharges a burst of [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]], and [[Lindon]] ultimately drives his own [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] through Brother Aekin{{!}}Aekin's chest.}}
